title: Sidewalk Simulator
description:
FEATURES:• Skill based combat + Base defense

• Tons of upgrades: Weapons, Walls, Turrets, Coin farms, Builders, Turrets, etc.

• CO-OP on a single keyboard or controllers

• 100+ unique enemies

• Hours of original music

Build walls, shields, and turrets, or take the fight into your own hands.

The Greediness system allows minimalist builds to be viable, and rewarding.

Unlock advanced items to upgrade your movement, weapons, economy, and base.

Return to previous worlds with new items to destroy unbeaten hoards and bosses.
description_short: Sidewalk Simulator combines fast-paced shootout combat with a deep tower defense upgrade economy. Build, dodge, unlock, and fight to survive endless waves of 100+ unique enemies. Find balance between movement, power, and defense in each strange world you encounter.
